properties.name: spring.flyway.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable Flyway database migrations.

properties.name: app.security.allow-weak-jwt-secret
properties.description: Allow a JWT secret shorter than 32 characters (dev/test only).

properties.name: app.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-separated list of allowed CORS origins.

properties.name: app.auth.frontend-base-url
properties.description: Base URL of the frontend, used for OAuth redirect callbacks.

properties.name: app.auth.access-token-ttl-minutes
properties.description: Lifetime of a JWT access token in minutes.

properties.name: app.auth.refresh-token-ttl-days
properties.description: Lifetime of a refresh token in days.

properties.name: app.auth.rate-limit.max-requests-per-minute
properties.description: Maximum authentication requests allowed per minute per IP.

properties.name: app.auth.bruteforce.max-failures
properties.description: Number of consecutive login failures before an account is locked.

properties.name: app.auth.bruteforce.lock-minutes
properties.description: Duration of a brute-force lock in minutes.

properties.name: app.auth.steam.realm
properties.description: Steam OpenID realm (the base URL of this server).

properties.name: app.auth.steam.return-url
properties.description: Steam OpenID return URL (callback endpoint).

properties.name: app.auth.discord.client-id
properties.description: Discord OAuth2 application client ID.

properties.name: app.auth.discord.client-secret
properties.description: Discord OAuth2 application client secret.

properties.name: app.auth.discord.redirect-uri
properties.description: Discord OAuth2 redirect URI.

properties.name: app.auth.github.client-id
properties.description: GitHub OAuth2 application client ID.

properties.name: app.auth.github.client-secret
properties.description: GitHub OAuth2 application client secret.

properties.name: app.auth.github.redirect-uri
properties.description: GitHub OAuth2 redirect URI.

properties.name: app.github.bot-token
properties.description: GitHub Personal Access Token used to grant collaborator access on purchase.

properties.name: app.shop.currency
properties.description: ISO 4217 currency code used for Stripe checkout.

properties.name: app.shop.success-url
properties.description: URL to redirect to after a successful Stripe checkout.

properties.name: app.shop.cancel-url
properties.description: URL to redirect to when a Stripe checkout is cancelled.

properties.name: app.shop.reconcile-interval-ms
properties.description: Interval in milliseconds between Stripe order reconciliation runs.

properties.name: app.shop.download-root
properties.description: Filesystem path (relative to working directory) where purchasable downloads are stored.

properties.name: app.stripe.secret-key
properties.description: Stripe secret API key.

properties.name: app.stripe.webhook-secret
properties.description: Stripe webhook endpoint signing secret.

properties.name: app.stripe.premium-price-id
properties.description: Stripe Price ID for the premium product.
